title: Hollingshead Cement opens cement terminal in Florida
summary: Hollingshead Cement opens cement terminal in Florida
body_markdown: **US:** Hollingshead Cement has opened a new 50,000t terminal in Tampa, Florida. The bulk cement division of SRM Concrete will use the site to support the supply of cement for its ready-mix concrete operations and other cement customers in the area. The unit will receive cement by ship.
